headline: Apple Watch Series 12 upgrades health tracking with new sensors and AI
summary: The new Series 12 boasts higher-frequency heart rate and HRV sensing, a readiness score, and enhanced privacy-focused Audio Intelligence features.
details: Apple has unveiled the Apple Watch Series 12, featuring an advanced Health Sensing System and the new S11 chip. This upgrade enables more accurate heart rate and heart rate variability (HRV) measurements, powering features like a new readiness score.

The S11 chip also introduces privacy-centric Audio Intelligence features for remembering conversations and identifying important sounds. These capabilities will be accessible via a redesigned Health app on iPhone later this year, including a new Longevity tab with a Health Age feature.

With watchOS 27, Apple Intelligence will bring contextual understanding and broad knowledge to Siri on the Apple Watch. This builds upon existing features like advanced workout tracking, sleep monitoring, and safety functions like Fall Detection and Emergency SOS.
The Apple Watch Series 12 offers continuous high-fidelity health monitoring through new optical and electrical heart sensors. Studies show its heart rate sensing accuracy surpasses leading wearables.
The device now measures heart rate every five seconds, providing more accurate Exercise and Move Activity rings. HRV is measured up to 24 times more often, offering insights into stress and recovery.

Available in finishes like dark bronze, black, light gold, space gray aluminum, radiant gold, and natural titanium, the Series 12 also features a tougher Ceramic Shield on aluminum models. Pre-orders are open now, with availability starting September 18.
